About the job
We are seeking a Software Engineer to contribute to the design and development
of a next-generation communications management suite. The successful candidate
will play a key role in designing robust software architectures, developing
microservices-based applications, and delivering solutions that enable the
monitoring, control, and management of complex communications networks. Working
within a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will tackle challenging
problems in distributed computing, networking, and real-time systems while
supporting mission-critical operational requirements and simulation environments.

Essential Functions
Design software solutions and contribute to software designs. Understand and
develop a microservices solution that operates in a complex, multi-network
environment. Conduct independent research and provide new solutions to problems.
Interact with systems engineering on technical issues. Debug software problems
for near real-time simulation. Conduct and prepare presentations and demonstrations.

Qualifications
Minimum seven years of software engineering experience including object-oriented
design and programming, C#, ASP.NET and .NET Core. Experience building web
applications using C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, REST APIs, HTTP, and SignalR.
Experience with client-server and networking protocols such as SNMP, WebSockets,
and the TCP stack. Experience with relational databases such as MySQL. Excellent
technical communication of ideas and design.

Preferred Additional Skills
Experience with CQRS, distributed systems and Akka. Experience designing and
developing highly available, fault tolerant and distributed systems. Experience
with message broker systems such as RabbitMQ. Strong organizational, analytical,
and problem-solving skills. Able to work independently and in a team-based
environment. Experience with web frameworks such as Vue.js or Angular. Knowledge
or experience developing or integrating applications. Experience with military
systems and standards.
